notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put the newest Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Smaug trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the second Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat from step 3.
